bugs.fix: BC gate: translate the fetch first; a block-compressed result can never be a resolve product, so aperture entries may not shadow it. Plus resolveDest-only aperture lookups for sampling and a BC-dest refusal in the Resolve hook. Verified: slot0 now binds the BC1 art at the same base the xenos-good capture samples. Background still black -> remaining issue is downstream (descriptor index at draw / blend / BC1 alpha), open.

bugs.error_message: Textured UI (press-A bg/A-button/logo) black: deferred-pool p145 drop latch permanently on; handoff pt10 blamed 'buffer retire gated on a D3D fence plume never signals'
bugs.root_cause: The retire-fence model was WRONG. IDA: pool+120 = SUBMIT sequence (incremented by 0x8245D5C0, misnamed audio_thread_link_shutdown = SubmitOpenBuffer, which also computes latch +145 = pend36 > thresh132 and lazily frees retired buffers). Hardware pacing = vblank ISR -> D3D::VerticalBlankInterrupt -> device+0x3F28 callback FM2_SignalGate (0x8220A4E8) -> PulseEvent(829C24C0) -> main game loop 0x822172E8 WaitForSingleObject = exactly 1 buffer submit per vblank. In plume OUR OWN StartGatePulseThreadOnce pulses that event at fm2_plume_gate_pulse_hz DEFAULT 1000 Hz, uncapping the producer; the pool then sits at the enqueue-backpressure equilibrium (backlog ~ 2x threshold = observed 14-17 w/ lifted thresh 8) with the latch on, dropping all a5==0 CParams including the textured-UI play-command-buffer ops.
bugs.fix: Pace the gate pulse like a real vblank. A/B at 60 Hz: submits ~45/s, backlog now periodically drains to 0 (never did before) but sawtooths to 17 (render thread stalls ~0.3-0.4s periodically) so p145 still latches in bursts; 30 Hz A/B run too. USER VERDICT: no visual difference at either rate; reverted to default 1000 (launch-flag A/B only, no code changed). Pacing decode stands as telemetry; textured-UI blocker is elsewhere (or residual latch bursts suffice). Next lead: verify the play-CB CParams are even recorded/enqueued in plume.
